The Houston Rockets host the Oklahoma City Thunder in the Rockets' seventh game of the 2026-27 season. Houston is 5-1 overall, 2-0 at home and 5-1 over its last ten, with a current L1 streak, and sits 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 2nd in the West. Oklahoma City is 4-1 overall, 3-0 at home and 4-1 over its last ten after five games, with a current L1 streak, and sits 1st in the Northwest and 4th in the West.

Houston is missing Alperen Sengun (back, soreness), Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee).

There have been no games between the teams in the 2026-27 season so far, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-2. The most recent meeting was a regular-season game on February 7, 2026, in Oklahoma City, which Houston won 112-106.
